questions.q: Which tag holds all the visible content of a web page?
questions.qAf: Watter etiket bevat al die sigbare inhoud van 'n webblad?
questions.explain: <body> holds all visible content (text, images, links). The <head> holds metadata and the <title>, which are not displayed on the page.
questions.explainAf: <body> bevat al die sigbare inhoud (teks, prente, skakels). Die <head> bevat metadata en die <title>, wat nie op die bladsy vertoon word nie.

questions.q: Which opening tag gives a list numbered with Roman numerals (i, ii, iii)?
questions.qAf: Watter openingsetiket gee 'n lys wat met Romeinse syfers (i, ii, iii) genommer is?
questions.explain: An ordered list's type can be 1, A, a or i; i gives Roman numerals.
questions.explainAf: 'n Geordende lys se type kan 1, A, a of i wees; i gee Romeinse syfers.

questions.q: What does the <hr/> tag do?
questions.qAf: Wat doen die <hr/>-etiket?
options: Draws a horizontal line that divides sections
optionsAf: Trek 'n horisontale lyn wat afdelings skei
questions.explain: <hr/> (hard return) is a self-closing tag that draws a horizontal line between sections.
questions.explainAf: <hr/> (hard return) is 'n selfsluitende etiket wat 'n horisontale lyn tussen afdelings trek.

questions.q: Which way of applying CSS lets one file style 50 or more pages?
questions.qAf: Watter manier om CSS toe te pas, laat een lêer 50 of meer bladsye stileer?
questions.explain: External CSS is a separate .css file linked with <link> in the <head>; it is the professional standard.
questions.explainAf: Eksterne CSS is 'n aparte .css-lêer wat met <link> in die <head> gekoppel word; dit is die professionele standaard.

questions.q: Which cell is the top-left cell of a spreadsheet?
questions.qAf: Watter sel is die sel heel links bo in 'n sigblad?
questions.explain: A cell address is the column letter first, then the row number. A1 is the top-left cell.
questions.explainAf: 'n Seladres is eers die kolomletter, dan die rynommer. A1 is die sel heel links bo.

questions.q: Cells B2 to B6 hold: 5, 7, (empty), 3, abc. What does =SUM(B2:B6) give?
questions.qAf: Selle B2 tot B6 bevat: 5, 7, (leeg), 3, abc. Wat gee =SUM(B2:B6)?
questions.explain: SUM adds the numbers and ignores text: 5 + 7 + 3 = 15.
questions.explainAf: SUM tel die getalle bymekaar en ignoreer teks: 5 + 7 + 3 = 15.

questions.q: Which chart is best for showing proportions of a whole, such as pass versus fail?
questions.qAf: Watter grafiek is die beste om dele van 'n geheel te wys, soos slaag teenoor druip?
questions.explain: A pie chart shows proportions or percentages of a whole; its slices run clockwise from 12 o'clock.
questions.explainAf: 'n Sirkelgrafiek wys verhoudings of persentasies van 'n geheel; die snye loop kloksgewys vanaf 12-uur.

questions.q: What is the next number in the pattern 3, 7, 11, 15, …?
questions.qAf: Wat is die volgende getal in die patroon 3, 7, 11, 15, …?
questions.explain: Each number is 4 more than the one before: 15 + 4 = 19.
questions.explainAf: Elke getal is 4 meer as die vorige een: 15 + 4 = 19.

questions.q: What is an IDE such as jGRASP?
questions.qAf: Wat is 'n IDE soos jGRASP?
options: A professional code editor with tools to run and check code
optionsAf: 'n Professionele koderedigeerder met hulpmiddels om kode te laat loop en na te gaan
questions.explain: An IDE is a code editor with extra tools: in jGRASP the Plus (+) button compiles and the red man runs the program.
questions.explainAf: 'n IDE is 'n koderedigeerder met ekstra hulpmiddels: in jGRASP stel die Plus- (+-)knoppie die program saam en die rooimannetjie laat dit loop.

questions.q: A voltmeter reads 4.5 V and an ammeter reads 0.015 A. What is the resistance?
questions.qAf: 'n Voltmeter lees 4,5 V en 'n ammeter lees 0,015 A. Wat is die weerstand?

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: Browsers ignore the Enter key in HTML source code.
questions.qAf: Blaaiers ignoreer die Enter-sleutel in HTML-bronkode.
questions.explain:
That is why you need

for paragraphs and
for a line break.
questions.explainAf:
Daarom het jy

vir paragrawe en
vir 'n reëlbreuk nodig.

questions.q: An ID selector in CSS starts with a full stop.
questions.qAf: 'n ID-selektor in CSS begin met 'n punt.
questions.explain: An ID starts with a hashtag (#H4-green); a class starts with a full stop (.red-text).
questions.explainAf: 'n ID begin met 'n hutsmerk (#H4-green); 'n klas begin met 'n punt (.red-text).

questions.q: Merge and Center joins the selected cells into one and centres the text.
questions.qAf: Merge and Center voeg die gekose selle saam tot een en sentreer die teks.
questions.explain: It is used for titles that span a table.
questions.explainAf: Dit word gebruik vir titels wat oor 'n tabel strek.

questions.q: Pattern recognition helps us to predict outcomes.
questions.qAf: Patroonherkenning help ons om uitkomste te voorspel.
questions.explain: For example weather forecasts and Netflix suggestions. In coding, a repeated command is a pattern: use a loop.
questions.explainAf: Byvoorbeeld weervoorspellings en Netflix-voorstelle. In kodering is 'n herhaalde opdrag 'n patroon: gebruik 'n lus.

questions.q: A Java variable name may start with a number, e.g. 1player.
questions.qAf: 'n Java-veranderlikenaam mag met 'n getal begin, bv. 1player.
questions.explain: A name cannot start with a number: player1 is fine, 1player is not.
questions.explainAf: 'n Naam mag nie met 'n getal begin nie: player1 is reg, 1player nie.

questions.q: In FreeCAD, Pocket makes a hole in a face.
questions.qAf: In FreeCAD maak Pocket 'n gat in 'n vlak.
questions.explain: Click the face, draw a closed shape, then select the Pocket tool. Pad does the opposite: it builds a 3D part from a sketch.
questions.explainAf: Klik op die vlak, teken 'n geslote vorm en kies dan die Pocket-hulpmiddel. Pad doen die teenoorgestelde: dit bou 'n 3D-onderdeel uit 'n skets.

questions.q: A digital Arduino port can have many values between 0 V and 5 V.
questions.qAf: 'n Digitale Arduino-poort kan baie waardes tussen 0 V en 5 V hê.
questions.explain: A digital port has only two states: HIGH (5 V) or LOW (0 V). An analog port has a wide range of values.
questions.explainAf: 'n Digitale poort het net twee toestande: HIGH (5 V) of LOW (0 V). 'n Analoë poort het 'n wye reeks waardes.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each Excel mouse pointer in column A with what it does in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke Excel-muiswyser in kolom A by wat dit doen in kolom B.
pairs: Selects a whole column or row
Drags content to a new place
questions.explain: The extra description in column B is Merge and Center, a button, not a pointer.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B is Merge and Center, 'n knoppie, nie 'n wyser nie.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each electrical term to its meaning.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke elektriese term aan sy betekenis.
pairs: Electrical pressure between two points, in volts
The flow of electrons, in amps
Opposition to the flow of current, in ohms
pairsAf: Elektriese druk tussen twee punte, in volt
Die vloei van elektrone, in ampère
Teenstand teen die vloei van stroom, in ohm
questions.explain: If the voltage doubles and the resistance stays the same, the current doubles.
questions.explainAf: As die spanning verdubbel en die weerstand dieselfde bly, verdubbel die stroom.

questions.q: Match each part of a Java program in column A with what it does in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke deel van 'n Java-program in kolom A by wat dit doen in kolom B.
pairs: Brings in extra tools, e.g. for pop-up windows
The entry point: the first place the computer looks
A pop-up box that asks the user for input
pairsAf: Bring ekstra hulpmiddels in, bv. vir opspringvensters
Die beginpunt: die eerste plek waar die rekenaar kyk
'n Opspringblokkie wat die gebruiker vir inset vra
questions.explain: The extra description in column B is the semicolon (;).
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B is die kommapunt (;).

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the parts of a web page in the order they appear in the code.
questions.qAf: Plaas die dele van 'n webblad in die volgorde waarin hulle in die kode verskyn.
questions.explain: DOCTYPE first, then the root <html>, then the <head> (metadata and title), then the <body>.
questions.explainAf: Eers DOCTYPE, dan die wortel <html>, dan die <head> (metadata en titel), dan die <body>.

questions.q: Put the steps of the automatic night light's Read–Process–Act cycle in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe van die outomatiese naglig se Lees–Verwerk–Reageer-siklus in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Read the light level from the LDR on A0 (input)
The program checks whether it is darker than the threshold (processing)
Switch the LED on or off (output)
Repeat forever while there is power
stepsAf: Lees die ligvlak van die LDR op A0 (inset)
Die program kyk of dit donkerder as die drempel is (verwerking)
Skakel die LED aan of af (uitset)
Herhaal vir altyd terwyl daar krag is
questions.explain: A microcontroller repeats Input → Processing → Output forever while it has power.
questions.explainAf: 'n Mikrobeheerder herhaal Inset → Verwerking → Uitset vir altyd terwyl dit krag het.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Thandi makes a recipe page. This is part of her code:
questions.scenarioAf: Thandi maak 'n resepbladsy. Dit is 'n deel van haar kode:
questions.code:
My Recipe

  1. Butter the bread
  2. Add the filling

questions.q: How will the two list items be marked?
questions.qAf: Hoe sal die twee lysitems gemerk word?
questions.explain: <ol type="1"> is an ordered list numbered 1, 2, 3.
questions.explainAf: <ol type="1"> is 'n geordende lys genommer 1, 2, 3.

questions.q: Why did Thandi add width and height to the image?
questions.qAf: Hoekom het Thandi width en height by die prent gevoeg?
options: So the browser leaves space and the layout does not shift
optionsAf: Sodat die blaaier spasie laat en die uitleg nie skuif nie
questions.explain: width and height are recommended: the browser leaves space so the layout does not shift. src and alt are the compulsory ones.
questions.explainAf: width en height word aanbeveel: die blaaier laat spasie sodat die uitleg nie skuif nie. src en alt is die verpligte attribute.

questions.q: Which change turns the list into a bulleted list with circles?
questions.qAf: Watter verandering maak van die lys 'n kolpuntlys met sirkels?
questions.explain: A bulleted list is an unordered list, <ul>, with type square, circle or disc.
questions.explainAf: 'n Kolpuntlys is 'n ongeordende lys, <ul>, met type square, circle of disc.

questions.q: The <li> tags may be left out because the list is short.
questions.qAf: Die <li>-etikette mag weggelaat word omdat die lys kort is.
questions.explain: Every list item must be wrapped in <li>.
questions.explainAf: Elke lysitem moet in <li> toegedraai word.

questions.scenario: Sizwe records the rainfall for each month. He types Jan in A2 and drags the Fill Handle down to A13.
questions.scenarioAf: Sizwe hou die reënval vir elke maand by. Hy tik Jan in A2 en sleep die vulhandvatsel af tot by A13.

questions.q: What appears in A3?
questions.qAf: Wat verskyn in A3?
questions.explain: AutoFill continues a built-in list: Jan → Feb → Mar.
questions.explainAf: AutoFill gaan voort met 'n ingeboude lys: Jan → Feb → Mar.

questions.q: He wants Jan copied into every cell instead. What should he do?
questions.qAf: Hy wil eerder hê Jan moet in elke sel gekopieer word. Wat moet hy doen?
options: Click the Option Box and choose Copy Cells
optionsAf: Klik die opsieblokkie en kies Copy Cells
questions.explain: After AutoFill, the Option Box lets you choose Copy Cells instead of filling a series.
questions.explainAf: Ná AutoFill laat die opsieblokkie jou Copy Cells kies in plaas daarvan om 'n reeks te vul.

questions.q: He wants the headers to stay visible while he scrolls. What should he use?
questions.qAf: Hy wil hê die opskrifte moet sigbaar bly terwyl hy blaai. Wat moet hy gebruik?
options: View tab, Freeze Panes, Freeze Top Row
optionsAf: View-oortjie, Freeze Panes, Freeze Top Row
questions.explain: Freeze Top Row keeps the header row visible while you scroll.
questions.explainAf: Freeze Top Row hou die opskrifry sigbaar terwyl jy blaai.

questions.q: Which chart best shows how the rainfall changed over the year?
questions.qAf: Watter grafiek wys die beste hoe die reënval oor die jaar verander het?
questions.explain: A line chart shows trends over time, such as rainfall month by month.
questions.explainAf: 'n Lyngrafiek wys neigings oor tyd, soos reënval van maand tot maand.

questions.scenario: Lebo writes this program for her Gogga, bug.
questions.scenarioAf: Lebo skryf hierdie program vir haar Gogga, bug.

questions.q: How many times does bug.move() run altogether?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer word bug.move() altesaam uitgevoer?
questions.explain: The inner loop moves 2 times per side and the outer loop repeats it 4 times: 4 × 2 = 8.
questions.explainAf: Die binneste lus beweeg 2 keer per sy en die buitenste lus herhaal dit 4 keer: 4 × 2 = 8.

questions.q: What shape does bug walk?
questions.qAf: Watter vorm loop bug?
questions.explain: Four sides with a right turn after each side make a square.
questions.explainAf: Vier sye met 'n regsdraai ná elke sy vorm 'n vierkant.

questions.q: Which loop is the outer loop?
questions.qAf: Watter lus is die buitenste lus?
questions.explain: The outer loop (sides) repeats the side and the turn; the inner loop (counter) draws one side.
questions.explainAf: Die buitenste lus (sides) herhaal die sy en die draai; die binneste lus (counter) teken een sy.

questions.q: bug.move(2); calls the move method with a parameter.
questions.qAf: bug.move(2); roep die move-metode met 'n parameter aan.
questions.explain: A value between the brackets is a parameter that the method receives.
questions.explainAf: 'n Waarde tussen die hakies is 'n parameter wat die metode ontvang.
